name: Bangkok, Thailand 🇹🇭
subtitle: Street food Michelin and fine dining jungle
items: Gaggan Anand (Gaggan Anand, Phrom Phong — progressive Indian, World's 50 Best, emoji-only menu)
Le Du (Silom, Thitid 'Ton' Tassanakajohn, #1 Asia 2023 — modern Thai seasonal)
Sorn (Suan Phlu, Supaksorn 'Ice' Jongsiri, 2-star — Southern Thai, extraordinary)
Jay Fai (Banglamphu, 1-star — crab omelet + pad kee mao from a street stall. Queue for hours.)
Nahm (Como Hotel, Silom, David Thompson — Thai cuisine as scholarship)
Charmgang (Charoen Krung, Jay Fai's protégé-adjacent, modern Thai)
Supanniga Eating Room (Thonglor + Tha Tien — traditional Thai family recipes elevated)
80/20 Bangkok (Charoen Krung, Napol 'Joe' Jantraget — ingredients-focused Thai)
Soul Food Mahanakorn (Ekkamai, Jarrett Wrisley — Thai gastropub, must-order cocktails)
Thip Samai (Mahachai, tourist-friendly but undeniably the best pad Thai)
Krua Apsorn (Dusit, Thai home cooking, very Thai — the royals eat here)
Gaggan's Canteen (new casual Gaggan offshoot)
Nahm at Como Hotel
Baan Ice (Gaggan's colleague chef, modern Thai at home style)
Ruean Mallika (Pratunam, traditional Royal Thai cuisine — rare)
Ristorante Buca Mario (just kidding — skip this one)
Chatuchak Weekend Market (JJ Market — the full Thai street food experience + shopping)
Chinatown (Yaowarat Road, evening food stalls — oyster omelettes, roast duck, crab fried rice)
Khao Yam stalls (Hat Yai–style, Chatuchak)
Ekamai Soi 10 area (roving street food at night)
